name: Clinic Care
summary: A family dental clinic website: prices in PKR, smile gallery, dentists, live booking slots and insurance
about: A ten-page website for a family dental clinic in Lahore, in clean white with aqua and soft coral. On the home page a drawn tooth loses its stains and starts to sparkle as you scroll through the five steps of a visit. Booking times flip like cards when you change day or dentist and keep changing live as other patients book and cancel; services with a treatment plan, a before and after smile gallery, insurance estimates, reviews, FAQ, directions and My visits all work.
how: Scroll the home page to clean the tooth step by step, then drag the line on the smile slider
Open Book a visit: pick a treatment, a dentist and a day, tap a free time and confirm with your name and mobile number
Add treatments to your plan on Services, change your insurance and watch what you pay count up
Build an estimate on Prices, spread it over 3, 6 or 12 months and save it
Filter the smile gallery, reviews and FAQ; write a review or ask a question
Move or cancel a visit, print a receipt and add family members on My visits
Press Ctrl+K to search treatments, dentists and answers; reset demo data from the footer
